entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pakudha Kaccāyana was an Indian teacher and philosopher who lived around the 6th century BCE, contemporaneous with Mahavira and the Buddha. He was an atomist who believed that everything was made of seven eternal elements – earth, water, fire, air, happiness, pain and soul.
